tools.name: check_tech_availability
tools.description: Return open 2-hour technician arrival windows for supported residential kitchen and laundry appliances (refrigeration, dishwasher, laundry, cooking, Bosch, Miele, Gaggenau, Sub-Zero). Do NOT call for unsupported services like pool heaters or water heaters. Omit zone to search all service areas.

zone.description: Optional service zone: north | central | south. Omit to search all zones.

skill.description: Canonical appliance skill: dishwasher, refrigeration, laundry, cooking, bosch, miele, gaggenau, general

appliance_type.description: Appliance category named by the caller (e.g. refrigerator, dishwasher)

tools.name: lookup_job
tools.description: Look up an active appointment by the caller's verified account phone number when they do not know their job ID.

customer_name.description: Optional caller name on the account

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a technician arrival window for a supported residential appliance using tech_id and window_start from check_tech_availability.

tech_id.description: Technician ID from open_windows (e.g. tech-sam, tech-mike)

window_start.description: ISO-8601 start timestamp of the open arrival window

tools.name: reschedule_parts_install
tools.description: Reschedule an existing parts installation appointment after verifying parts are in stock.

preferred_date.description: Requested new install datetime in ISO-8601

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel an existing appointment after 2FA verification (requires BOTH job_id and account phone). Enforces the $85 fee for appointments within 24 hours — call with confirmed=false first, get verbal confirmation of the $85 fee, then call again with confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the caller verbally agrees to the $85 late cancellation fee

tools.name: transfer_to_dispatcher
tools.description: Transfer the caller to a human dispatcher when requested, when 2FA phone verification fails, or when an unsupported service request requires escalation.

reason.description: Concise reason for human dispatcher escalation
